top_story.title: Stocks Rally After Treasury Says It Will Increase Buybacks
top_story.summary: The stock market was rallying Wednesday morning after the Treasury Department said it would double the size of long-dated debt buyback operations.  The Nasdaq Composite was up 0.4%.  The Treasury said it will double liquidity support operations for long-dated nominal coupon securities to $4 billion per operation starting Sept. 9 through Nov. 4.
